objective: Reusable invitation-copy button; standalone local fixture only

requirements.C01-R01: Native TypeScript/plain CSS; reusable, no libraries/icons/marketing page
requirements.C01-R02: Exact invitation label and URL; clipboard action
requirements.C01-R04: Success label Link copied for approximately 2000ms then reset
requirements.C01-R05: Clipboard missing/rejection yields useful inline error and retry
requirements.C01-R06: Native keyboard support, live status, focus indicator, >=44px target
requirements.C01-R07: 320px and supplied translated label fit; restrained styling; runnable instructions

assumptions: Requirement IDs are assigned in task order because input supplies IDs without individual text mappings
System fonts and a light theme are sufficient; browser clipboard requires localhost/HTTPS
decisions: Native button; pending aria-disabled plus synchronous handler guard preserves focus
Persistent polite live region; selectable fallback URL on errors
No motion; content-wrapping min-height button; scoped semantic color tokens
stateContract: idle -> pending -> success -> idle after 2000ms; pending -> error -> pending on retry; dispose ignores async completion and clears timer
acceptance: Render desktop and narrow; measure contrast
verificationLimits: Screen reader speech and real-user performance unavailable
Browser tests use deterministic clipboard adapters in addition to actual browser clipboard
